description: This file implements classes and functions for managing F1-U split connector, including adapters for GTP-U tunnels, session management, and bearer creation/disconnection in a 5G network context.

classes.name: gtpu_tx_udp_gw_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for transmitting PDUs over GTP-U via UDP, notifying upper layers.

classes.name: gtpu_rx_f1u_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for receiving SDUs from GTP-U and passing UL messages to upper layer.

classes.name: network_gateway_data_gtpu_demux_adapter
classes.description: Adapter between network gateway data and GTP-U demux, handling PDU forwarding.

classes.name: f1u_split_gateway_cu_bearer
classes.description: Represents a CU bearer in the F1-U split, managing GTP-U tunnels and adapters.

classes.name: f1u_split_connector
classes.description: Main class managing the creation, attachment, and disconnection of CU bearers and GTP-U tunnels.

methods.name: on_new_pdu
methods.description: Handles new PDU for GTP-U transmission.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the adapter to a session or handler.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the adapter from its handler.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Handles new SDU for GTP-U reception.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the demux adapter to a GTP-U demux.

methods.name: on_new_pdu
methods.description: Forwards received PDU to the demux.

methods.name: f1u_split_gateway_cu_bearer
methods.description: Constructor initializing a CU bearer with session info and adapters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the CU bearer, disconnecting and stopping queues.

methods.name: get_bind_address
methods.description: Retrieves the bind address of the session.

methods.name: f1u_split_connector
methods.description: Constructor setting up session managers and default sessions.

methods.name: create_cu_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new CU bearer, setting up GTP-U tunnels and attaching to demux.

methods.name: attach_dl_teid
methods.description: Attaches downlink TEID to an existing CU bearer, creating uplink and downlink tunnels.

methods.name: disconnect_cu_bearer
methods.description: Disconnects and removes a CU bearer based on UL TEID.
